board: PCF8591 AD/DA converter module YL-40 (SCL, SDA, GND, VCC / AOUT, AIN0-AIN3)
reason: Check passed on ESP32 and Pico on the first run. The I2C model answers each control byte (channels 0-3, with and without AOUT enabled, plus auto-increment) with 8-bit codes = Vin*256/VREF, using the datasheet's 1 LSB = VREF/256 and assuming VREF = VCC = 3.3 V. The driver discards the stale first byte of each read, as the datasheet requires. The AOUT/DAC output is not simulated.
breakoutPinoutSource: https://protosupplies.com/product/pcf8591-a-d-and-d-a-converter-module/ (headers SCL,SDA,GND,VCC and AOUT,AIN0-AIN3; jumpers P5=LDR/AIN0, P4=thermistor/AIN1, P6=pot/AIN3), cross-checked with https://wiki.kewl.org/interfaces:adda
